resource: Shared-XP vocation bonus before the equal split
allocation_impact: One normalized vocation gives +20% for creatures worth at least 20 XP; two, three, four or more give +30%, +60%, +100%. Summon deduction precedes equal ceiling shares; individual Prey and stamina follow.
boundary_tests: 1 through 5 vocations, below-20 threshold and summon deduction: shared_experience_vocation_bonus_ceiling_and_summon_deduction; i64::MAX oracle: shared_experience_bound_and_wide_integer_oracle
